fields.title: Week of Oct 20 – Oct 26
fields.headline: Revenue on pace; paid ads and response time slipping.
fields.body:
**Overall:** 22% of the way through the quarter by revenue, with 29% of the time gone.

**At risk**
- Paid ads return fell to 2.05x as holiday CPMs rose.
- First replies the same day fell to 66% as ticket volume rose 40%.

**Changed since last week**
- New carrier cut cost per order to $8.15.
- 31 qualified wholesale deals after the trade show.

fields.title: Week of Oct 27 – Nov 2
fields.headline: Revenue on pace; three key results need a decision this week.
fields.body:
**Overall:** net revenue $1.38M, 33% of the $4.2M target with 37% of the quarter gone. 7 of 14 key results on track, 4 on watch, 3 at risk.

**Growth** — List at 205k; paid ads at 2.0x against a 3.0x target. Action: move $18k a week to retargeting.

**Sales** — 9 stores signed of 40; pipeline $520k is ahead of plan. 22 deals have no next step.

**Operations** — Monday shift lifted on-time shipping to 74%; two hero SKUs still out until Nov 9.

**Support** — 1,410 tickets last week; same-day first reply 64%. Action: agent-drafted replies for order-status tickets.

**Decisions for Monday**
1. Shift $18k a week of ad budget to retargeting.
2. Let the support agent draft order-status replies.
3. Run the subscriber win-back offer (one free box, 640 subscribers).
